title: Veni, sancte spiritus (Gaspar, In honorem sancti spiritus)
desc: Gaspar van Weerbeke, In honorem sancti spiritus, Veni, sancte spiritus. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Gas0303b), edited by Andrea Lindmayr-Brandl (Gaspar van Weerbeke: Collected Works. III. The Motet Cycles, 1998); encoded by Roland Mair-Gruber. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
